<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script_include"><sys_ux_client_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><api_name>x_1529240_taskbudd.Date_Validation</api_name><includes/><name>Date_Validation</name><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[function include({imports}) { 
    var dueDateStr = g_form.getValue('due_date');
    if (dueDateStr) {
        var dueDate = new Date(dueDateStr);
        
        var currentDate = new Date();
        currentDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

        if (dueDate < currentDate) {

            g_form.showFieldMsg('due_date', 'Das Due Date darf nicht in der Vergangenheit liegen!', 'error');
            return false;
        }
    }

    return true;}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-02-10 08:41:26</sys_created_on><sys_id>f859c00b83a31210e9ef58a6feaad3c4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Date_Validation</sys_name><sys_package display_value="TaskBuddy" source="x_1529240_taskbudd">9ea39f5383321210e9ef58a6feaad3b7</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="TaskBuddy">9ea39f5383321210e9ef58a6feaad3b7</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_include_f859c00b83a31210e9ef58a6feaad3c4</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-02-10 08:41:26</sys_updated_on></sys_ux_client_script_include></record_update>
